_comment: RGBMatrixFX preset file (example). Import it with File > Import presets... Export your own with File > Export all presets... (or Presets > Export this preset...). Field reference: examples/presets/README.md

presets._comment: Preset name -> profile. Names that clash with existing presets get ' (2)'.

Example: Wave + WASD._comment: One preset = one profile. Unknown keys (like these _comment ones) are ignored on import; missing keys get their defaults. Field reference: examples/presets/README.md
Example: Wave + WASD._comment_effect: Active effect id: flame, wave, spectrum, breathing, static, starlight, fire, reactive, ripple, wheel, matrix, aurora, heatmap, audio

effects._comment: Per-effect settings, keyed by effect id. Only the effects you list are changed.

reactive._comment: Reactive layer: ripples/fades on key presses and mouse clicks

highlights._comment: Keys held at a fixed colour. Key names: evdev names without KEY_ (W, SPACE, LEFTSHIFT, KP5) or LOGO
highlights.name: WASD

zones._comment: Per-zone overrides: mode follow|static|breathing|spectrum|off, colour, speed, brightness 0-1, reactive
